collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager stepped in a deep puddle at dawn and both sandals will not dry: take them off, or squelch on.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: First thing this morning, (subject) stepped into a deep puddle. Both feet. Both sandals. They have been wet all day. Every step: squelch. Squelch. Squelch. They're not drying. The sun is out and they're still not drying. It's a very small thing, and it has completely taken over (subject)'s day.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) takes the sandals off and goes barefoot. Much better. Then (subject.he/she) steps on a sharp shell. Then a hot stone. Then something squishy (subject.he/she) doesn't look at. (subject.He/she) puts the wet sandals back on. Squelch. "Some days," (subject.he/she) tells (friend), "there is no right answer."

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) keeps squelching. By the afternoon (subject.he/she) has stopped noticing it most of the time. By evening, the sandals are finally dry. (subject.He/she) sits by the fire, feet warm, very content. Then (subject.he/she) gets up to fetch water and steps in the same puddle. Both feet. (friend) has to leave the fire to laugh.
